Counsel for Applicant :- Shri Nivas Rathore
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
In terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that the applicant used to physically exploit the victim for a term of three years and she also became pregnant.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has drawn my attention to the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. filed alongwith the counter affidavit of the State wherein the victim has stated that she does not want to pursue the matter and the compromise has been arrived at between the parties.
The applicant is in jail since 29.3.2023 and has no criminal history, hence the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Pankaj Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. also opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Without going into the question of compromise affecting the trial, the fact emerges that the relationship between the victim and the applicant continued for over a period of three years coupled with the fact that the applicant is in jail since 29.3.2023 having no criminal history and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Pankaj Kumar Singh be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.110 of 2023,
under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Shukla  Pankaj Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139189604/
